evidence:
Workbook row 15: 'Agent image is pinned, pre-installs every runtime dependency (no run-time install), and stages the assets.' Skill quality-checks.md:67-68 verify list applied item by item against task/environment/Dockerfile (SHA256 0a75419e...467d1, equal to the manifest entry and byte-identical to the frozen template environment/Dockerfile).

1. Pinned base: Dockerfile:1 'FROM node:22-bookworm-slim' (version+distro tag, no latest, no --platform). Same line as the template.
2. Runtime dependencies pre-installed and pinned: Dockerfile:9-12 'npm install -g --no-audit --no-fund express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1', with Dockerfile:3 'ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules' matching the global install root. These are exactly the versions the skill names.
3. Dependency closure of the reference: solution/app/package.json:13-16 declares only better-sqlite3 12.4.1 and express 5.1.0. A grep of every require/import under solution/app found only better-sqlite3, express and Node built-ins (crypto, fs, node:http, node:worker_threads, path). No child_process/spawn use, so the apt tools are not app runtime dependencies.
4. No run-time install: solve.sh (36 lines) contains no npm/npx/apt/pip/curl/wget; it only checks the database is idle, 'cp -a .../app/. /app/' (line 35) and removes the database files. A grep of tests/test.sh for install commands found none; it launches with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (test.sh:106, 162). A grep of solution/, instruction.md and environment/instructions for remote URLs or install commands returned nothing. The brief agrees with the image: integration.md:3-5 'Express and better-sqlite3 already available through NODE_PATH; use only those packages and Node built-ins'.
5. Assets staged: Dockerfile:14 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', Dockerfile:15 'COPY assets/ /assets/', Dockerfile:16 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'. Both COPY sources exist (environment/instructions/{hireops_rules.md,integration.md}, environment/assets/seed_data.json); the seed parses as JSON and is byte-equal to solution/app/src/seed_data.json (SHA256 1b390154...8bcf7).
6. /app created, git-initialised and empty apart from .gitkeep: Dockerfile:17-23; WORKDIR /app and CMD sleep infinity at 25-26.
7. Named defects absent: no COPY/ADD of solution/ or tests/ anywhere in the file; no install step that needs network at grade time. task.toml has no [environment].docker_image and no allow_internet (grep returned no match), so the Dockerfile is not shadowed; build_timeout_sec = 600.0.
8. Verifier parity (supports 'no run-time install' at grade time): tests/Dockerfile:20-21 installs the same express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 with the same NODE_PATH (line 9); tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template (SHA256 72998ab8...f55fdd).

Adversarial reads. Plausible broken variant that would still look fine: an image that pinned the packages but set a NODE_PATH not matching the global root, or omitted the chmod so a non-root agent could not read /assets; neither applies here (lines 3, 16). Conforming alternative that could fail: a submission that shells out to the sqlite3 CLI, which the agent image installs (Dockerfile:6) but the verifier image does not (tests/Dockerfile:12-13). The brief restricts builders to the two packages plus Node built-ins, the golden does not do this, and both files are template-controlled, so this is a latent P3 observation for the shared template rather than a defect of this task.

Not measured, stated so it is not read as covered. (a) This review is static. I started no container and built no image, and raw-evidence-index.json has no agent-image build bound to this input hash: all 10 entries (hashes recomputed, all match) are scripted golden runs inside hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair. Their server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000', which shows the same two pinned packages load under the Node 22 runtime in the verifier image; it is not a build of the agent image. Local tags hireops-agent:20261001-* exist but are not hash-bound to this candidate and predate the 2 October change to environment/instructions, so I do not count them. Row 15's procedure in the skill is a source inspection, so I do not treat a build log as required evidence for this row; a cold-build timing against build_timeout_sec belongs to row 11 and parse/run to row 51. (b) The base is tag-pinned, not digest-pinned, apt packages are unversioned (workbook: 'unpinned apt is a NOTE'), and transitive npm dependencies are resolved at build time with no lockfile. All three are inherited unchanged from the template. (c) I did not run the private check-dockerfiles.py, check-fixtures.py or check-runtime-deps-in-both-images.py; the statements above are manual application of their documented behaviour.
